Carlos Alcaraz: Carlos Alcaraz arrives in strong form after winning the Erste Bank Open in Vienna by defeating Alex de Minaur, capping off a perfect ATP 500 season. He is now eager to carry that momentum into the Rolex Paris Masters following a second-round appearance.
Taylor Fritz: Taylor Fritz enters the match in strong form after defeating Arthur Fils to claim his 100th Masters 1000 win, keeping his ATP Finals qualification hopes alive. Nuno Borges: Nuno Borges enters the quarter-finals of the Rolex Paris Masters in strong form, making history as the first lucky loser to reach this stage of the tournament. His recent results include a dominant 6-0, 6-2 sweep of Ignacio Buse, following a previous win over Moïse Kouamé.
Casper Ruud: Casper Ruud enters strong form at the Rolex Paris Masters, defeating Rafael Jodar in straight sets to advance through the early rounds. He is now set to play a quarter-final rematch against Nuno Borges.
